description: This Java class `CreatePolicySubstitutionStrategy` handles substitution logic for policies within the context of creating policies via the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract substitution strategy to modify `CreatePolicy` commands by substituting the policy content, primarily for placeholder handling.

classes.name: CreatePolicySubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends an abstract substitution strategy to handle substitution within `CreatePolicy` commands, focusing on replacing policy data.

methods.name: CreatePolicySubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy for `CreatePolicy` types.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the substitution algorithm to a `CreatePolicy` object, potentially replacing its policy content with a substituted version.
